hero_subtitle: The Miraculous Sleeping Idol established by Arjuna
mantra_text: Manojavan Marutatulyavegam Jitendriyam Buddhimatam Varishtham | Vatatmajam Vanarayuthamukhyam Shriramadutam Sharanam Prapadye ||
about_text: Sakariya Hanuman (Bhid Bhanjan) Temple features a rare 10-foot long sleeping idol of Hanumanji. History suggests that during the Mahabharata era, the Pandavas stayed here. On Lord Krishna's advice, Arjuna established and worshipped this idol before the war.
holy_memories_subtitle: Explore the beautiful moments from our past Celebrations, Rituals, and Community Gatherings.
footer_about_text: Dedicated to Lord Hanuman, a place of peace, devotion, and supreme power. Join us for Darshan and seek the blessings of Anjaniputra.
about_description_2: Experience the divine atmosphere and find inner peace. The temple architecture is a marvel of ancient Indian craftsmanship.
donation_desc: Your contribution helps us maintain the temple, serve free prasad to thousands of devotees, and conduct social welfare activities.
bhandara_desc: We invite you to participate in the grand 3-day Mahotsav on 22, 23, and 24 April 2026. Contribute towards the Mahaprasadi (Bhandara) by donating essential grocery and vegetable items or contributing cash.
online_donation_desc: Create a positive impact from anywhere in the world.
bank_transfer_desc: Directly transfer to the Temple Trust account.
scan_donate_desc: Use any UPI app to scan and make a donation.
tax_exemption_note: Donations are exempt from Income Tax under section 80G.
live_desc: Watch live Aarti and Darshan directly from the temple premises. Morning Aarti: 7:00 AM | Evening Aarti: 7:00 PM
whatsapp_desc: Join our official WhatsApp group to receive daily Darshan, event updates, and news directly on your phone. Be a part of our growing spiritual family.
click_to_join: or click the link to join
parking_desc: Ample parking space available for cars, buses, and two-wheelers. Safe and guarded premises.
garden_desc: Beautiful garden and children's play area for families to relax and kids to enjoy.
gift_shop_desc: Everything you need for worship: Malas, Hanumanji Photo Frames, and headbands. We also offer packaged food, water bottles.
event_facilities_desc: Temple provides open ground and kitchen facilities for holding religious events and social functions.
ro_water_desc: Chilled and purified drinking water stations available at multiple points in the campus.
shoe_stand_desc: Free shoe keeping facility managed by volunteers to keep your footwear safe while you do Darshan.
wheelchair_desc: Wheelchairs available for elderly and differently-abled devotees at the main gate.
diwali_desc: Grand celebration of the festival of lights with special rituals, lamps, and cultural performances.
satyanarayana_puja_desc: Monthly community Satyanarayana puja performed for the well-being of devotees.
janmashtami_desc: Celebrating the birth of Lord Krishna with fervor and joy.
no_events_found: No events found in this category.
hanuman_janmotsav_desc: Grand celebration of Hanuman Janmotsav with special pious rituals, Maha Aarti, and Santvani.
temple_renovation_desc: Celebrating the renovation of the temple with Vedic Chanting and Abhishek.

botad_junction_desc: The nearest major railway station, approximately 12 km away.
ahmedabad_junction_desc: About 150 km away. Connected to all major cities.
bus_details_1: Direct GSRTC buses are available from Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, and Botad.
bus_details_2: Private luxury buses and taxis are also frequently available.
